prompt: Create a new file named string_utils.py in the workspace root. It must define two functions. slugify(text): lowercase the text, strip leading and trailing whitespace, and replace every run of internal whitespace with a single hyphen '-'. shout(text): return the text uppercased with a single trailing '!'. Give each function a short docstring. You do not need to add tests.

metadata.summary: Create a small string-utility module with two functions.
